description_en: Queries the list of ports on a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device that have a routable protocol enabled. This operation is applicable to SAG instances that are associated with an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G device of version 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 获取SAG设备路由协议开启的端口列表，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag view-smart-access-gateway-port-route-protocol --sag-ins-id sag-sv487b7lno6go50000 --sag-sn sagf4dk0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ViewSmartAccessGatewayPortRouteProtocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the Smart Access Gateway instances that belong to other accounts. Valid values:

false (default): No.
true: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

false（默认值）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: cross_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the Smart Access Gateway instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

NeighborIp.description_en: The IP address of the neighbor

RemoteAs.description_en: The autonomous system (AS) number of the BGP peer

RemoteIp.description_en: The IP address of the peer

RouteProtocol.description_en:
The routable protocol of the port. Valid values:

STATIC: static routing protocol.
OSPF: Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) dynamic routing protocol.
BGP: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) dynamic routing protocol
RouteProtocol.description_zh:
端口路由协议。取值：

STATIC：静态路由协议。
OSPF：OSPF动态路由协议。
BGP：BGP动态路由协议

Status.description_en:
The status of the port. Valid values:

UP: The port is enabled.
DOWN: The port is disabled
Status.description_zh:
端口状态。取值：

UP：端口开启。
DOWN：端口关闭

TaskStates.description_en: The status of the query task

items.description_en: The status of the query task

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the query task was created.

This is a UNIX timestamp that represents the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
CreateTime.description_zh:
查询任务创建时间戳。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建查询任务时的总时长

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. \`200\` indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. \`Successful\` indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task:

Initialized: The query task is being initialized.
Offline: The SAG device is offline and the query task is not sent. The task will be sent after the device goes online.
Succeed: The query task is sent.
Processing: The query task is being sent.
VersionNotSupport: The current version of the SAG device is not supported.
BuildRequestError: The management plane does not support the operation.
HardwareError: The query task failed to be sent due to a device error.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The SAG device is offline and the query task is not sent. The task will not be sent even after the device goes online
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
